source.method: use_figma read-only scripts: figma.variables.getLocalVariableCollectionsAsync, getLocalVariablesAsync, getLocalTextStylesAsync, getLocalEffectStylesAsync, getLocalPaintStylesAsync
notes: Every collection has exactly one mode. Colors are 6 digit hex, or 8 digit hex (RRGGBBAA) when alpha is below 1.
Primitives are all hiddenFromPublishing with no scopes; they exist only to be aliased by the Color collection.
Color/* values are aliases into Primitives; 'resolved' is the hex the alias resolves to in the default mode.
codeSyntax holds the WEB name used in the live app's CSS; the brand purple is still called 'iqly-green' there.
Line height and letter spacing values are rounded to two decimals (Figma stores float noise like 139.9999976).

Avatar holds the illustrated avatar palette (skin and cloth tones with their -shade pairs, hair, eye, background and single colours). Its values are literal hex, not aliases, and its mode is called Default.
